text:
eval-bot: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT: model-redwood-v2-quantized failed 3 suites: summarization, codegen, instruction-following. Severity: auto-assigned HIGH. Dashboard: https://internal.eval.redwood/suites/176350 (details in alert)

Sam Nguyen: Saw the alert, pulling eval logs now.
Maya Patel: assigning to Priya for triage?
Priya Rao: taking ownership, will run a local repro.
Li Chen: quick Q — is this for quantized only or do fp32 runs also fail?
Priya Rao: good call, running fp32 vs int8 diff on nightly prompt set.
Oliver Brooks: I glanced at the diffs earlier; summarization outputs are noticeably shorter and drop key facts.
Sam Nguyen: setting initial severity = P2 until Priya confirms regression depth.
Priya Rao: repro steps: checked model-redwood-v2-quantized on nightly subset. Sample below:
```
INPUT: "Summarize the following article about urban transit..."
EXPECTED: "1) key change 2) ridership impact 3) policy implications"
ACTUAL: "No summary available"
```
Maya Patel: tagging infra: @Jason L can you check if any quantization/kernel flags changed last night?
Jason L: I deployed a kernel tweak at 02:10 UTC (tiling change for seq_len>1024). Rolling back to test now.
Jason L: logs: `kernel_update: tiling=v2 -> v1` at 2026-03-10T02:10Z
Priya Rao: fp32 run on same prompt set passes; quantized fails consistently. Points to quantization path or kernel interaction.
Li Chen: OK that narrows it. Priya, can you diff logits/topk between fp32 and int8 for the failing examples?
Priya Rao: running compare now, will post results in ~30m.
Sam Nguyen: ops question — can we temporarily route summarization production traffic to fp32 variant for canaries? Better safe until we know impact.
Maya Patel: ops: keep it internal for now, P2. If we see customer error spikes escalate to P1.
Priya Rao: mitigation: adding a model-variant rule to prefer fp32 for 'summarization' route for the next 6 hours. Coordinating with eng-oncall.
Oliver Brooks: I'll add the failing prompt set to the regression alert so new model brings catch this automatically.
Priya Rao: found a clue: int8 logits show suppressed low-prob tokens causing beam/greedy collapse. Shared softmax diffs in the eval artifact.
Sam Nguyen: thanks. Owners and next steps: Priya -> triage + compare; Li -> quantization recalibration experiments; Jason -> confirm kernel rollback impact; Oliver -> update eval suite and regression tags.
Maya Patel: tagging owners explicitly: Priya (triage), Li (quant), Jason (infra), Oliver (eval). :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: will update when compare completes and paste the minimal repro + failing examples.
Sam Nguyen: sounding plan. If the rollback fixes it, schedule a canary deploy of kernel v1 and run full nightly.
